mission: Define and deterministically validate a candidate-only, domain-agnostic constitutional lifecycle, including one bounded full-system causal path and up to three pre-outcome zero-authority single-contributor shadow predictions whose later deterministic comparisons may only withhold existing grounded credit eligibility.

authority_boundary.legacy_reference: ROGALDaemon and AutonomousCycle remain the deployed reference authority.

preservation_policy: Legacy, alternate, dormant, experimental, and forgotten mechanisms remain classified and preserved until explicitly retired.
